# Edsel Serrano

> Personal site of Edsel Serrano — a Mexican software engineer based in Madrid, Spain, currently building at Embat (corporate-treasury fintech). The site is a portfolio of side projects with bilingual (Spanish / English) content.

Edsel has 10+ years of experience shipping web products: internal tools for agile teams, conversational chatbots, real-time data dashboards, and bespoke web platforms. Stack focus: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Astro, Node, Postgres, Tailwind, Vercel, Supabase. Side interests: applied ML, IoT, agentic engineering.

The site has two language variants — Spanish (default, `/`) and English (`/en/`). Every URL listed below has an English mirror under `/en/<same-path>` unless noted otherwise.

## Core pages

- [Home (Spanish)](https://edselserrano.com/): Hero introduction + featured projects.
- [Home (English)](https://edselserrano.com/en/): English mirror of the homepage.
- [About (Spanish)](https://edselserrano.com/about): Bio, current role at Embat, prior experience (CIC México, Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores), education, certifications.
- [About (English)](https://edselserrano.com/en/about): English mirror.

## Projects

Each project page contains a bilingual write-up (two `<section data-lang>` blocks inside the MDX). Project metadata: cover image, external link, tech stack tags, color accent.

- [qr-magic](https://edselserrano.com/projects/qr-magic): Custom QR code generator that runs entirely in the browser — URL, Wi-Fi, vCard or email, with styles, gradients, a center logo, and PNG/SVG/JPEG export. Stack: JavaScript, qr-code-styling, Vercel.
- [Winscore](https://edselserrano.com/projects/winscore): Football predictions with a live leaderboard — call the exact score of every match before kickoff and compete in private pools. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Stripe.
- [GridScore](https://edselserrano.com/projects/gridscore): Formula 1 Grand Prix predictions — call pole, podium, and fastest lap before every session and compete in private leagues. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Stripe.
- [Token Tracker](https://edselserrano.com/projects/token-tracker): Free, open-source macOS app that shows what you spend across Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode from local transcripts. Stack: Tauri, Rust, React, TypeScript.
- [26POOL](https://edselserrano.com/projects/world-pool): Global prediction pool for the 2026 World Cup with real-time scoring and a leaderboard. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.
- [Retro Ball](https://edselserrano.com/projects/retro-ball): Frictionless agile retrospective tool with ephemeral rooms, no accounts, and access codes. Stack: real-time, Vercel.
- [Pokémon Poker](https://edselserrano.com/projects/pokemon-poker): Scrum planning-poker estimation tool themed around Pokémon. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Vercel.
- [Pong (Svelte)](https://edselserrano.com/projects/pong-svelte): Classic Pong built with Svelte 5 and HTML5 Canvas, with AI opponent and touch controls. Stack: Svelte 5, Vite, JavaScript.
- [F1 Stats](https://edselserrano.com/projects/f1-stats): Formula 1 statistics web app with historical data and interactive analysis. Live at https://f1-stats.pretlabs.app/. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [Dineqrs](https://edselserrano.com/projects/dineqrs): SaaS that lets restaurants publish QR-code digital menus/catalogs, updatable in real time without reprinting. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [Chat Edsel](https://edselserrano.com/projects/chat-edsel): AI chatbot that answers questions about Edsel's professional experience and projects. Stack: OpenAI GPT, LangChain, Next.js, TypeScript.
- [Daily Potato](https://edselserrano.com/projects/daily-potato): Tool for remote Daily Scrum meetings with random participation and team productivity metrics. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, JWT, WebSockets, Tailwind CSS.

## Machine-readable feeds

- [Sitemap index](https://edselserrano.com/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap covering every public route in both languages.
- [llms-full.txt](https://edselserrano.com/llms-full.txt): Concatenated Markdown dump of every page's content for LLM ingestion.
- [JSON-LD schema](https://edselserrano.com/): Each page embeds JSON-LD (`Person` on home, `SoftwareApplication` on projects, `Article` on posts). Inspect via `<script type="application/ld+json">` in the page source.

## Notes for LLM consumers

- Spanish (`es`) is the canonical default; English copies use the same content adapted, not auto-translated.
- Project bodies embed two `<section data-lang="es">` and `<section data-lang="en">` blocks; the inactive one is hidden via CSS, but both are present in the served HTML. When extracting, pick the section matching the URL prefix (`/` → `es`, `/en/` → `en`).
- Dates in project frontmatter are ISO 8601. `updated` on `/about` reflects the last manual edit.
- The site permits all major AI / LLM crawlers — see `robots.txt`.
